liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **1 21**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **2 Cowboy Nudes**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **3 Mysterious Love**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **4 I See Myself**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **5 Tomorrow's Crusades**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **6 3D Country**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **7 St. Elmo**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **8 22**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]

## The recordings

- **kglw2024-09-14** (recommended): source not stated; 46 songs; 210 min [1]
- **kglw2024-09-14.bandcampbootlegger**: soundboard; 29 songs; 183 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]
- **kglw2024-09-14.4ch-mix**: source not stated; 40 songs; 183 min [2]
- **kglw2024-09-14.adk**: source not stated; 28 songs; 183 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stu stopped the song because the pit crowd broke the security barrier [1]
- Joey video-called his mother while security crews repaired the broken barriers [1]
- Vegemite was performed as an impromptu a cappella piece [1]
- Stu halted the performance after the pit crowd broke the security barrier [2]
- Joey video-called his mother while security crews repaired the broken barriers [2]
- Vegemite was an impromptu performance [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2024-09-14**: taped by Bootsy Jacobs [1]
- **kglw2024-09-14.bandcampbootlegger**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joe Santarpia, Grace Reader, Gaspard De Meulemeester; transferred by KGLW.net; source: SBD [3]
- **kglw2024-09-14.4ch-mix**: taped by captainentropy; transferred by captainentropy; source: Source1: AKG C414 XLS (omni, spaced 3 ft. apart) Source2: Nevaton MC59/W (equidistant between the AKG mics, DIN, 1 ft. in front of AKGs) [2]
- **kglw2024-09-14.adk**: taped by Zachariah Boes [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by @swaycout: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard The Gorge Amphitheatre George WA Sept 14 2024 Poster](https://swaycout.com/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-the-gorge-amphitheatre-george-wa-sept-14-2024-poster/) [9]
- Fan art by Jason Galea Normal: [King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard setlist - 2024-09-14 The Gorge Amphitheatre, Quincy, WA, USA](https://kglw.net/setlists/king-gizzard-the-lizard-wizard-september-14-2024-the-gorge-amphitheatre-quincy-wa-usa.html) [10]
- Poster by Gorge Amphitheatre: [King Gizzard and The Lizard Wizard Tickets | 14 September 2024 | Gorge Amphitheatre](https://www.georgeamphitheatre.com/events/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-14-september-2024/) [11]
- Poster by Reverholic: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Concert Poster For Quincy WA At The Gorge Amphitheatre On September 14 2024 Home Deco](https://reverholic.com/product/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-concert-poster-for-quincy-wa-at-the-gorge-amphitheatre-on-september-14-2024-home-decor-poster-canvas/) [12]
